author: Derek Smith
reply: Derek, "underground devil footed blind rats" might be the best description of a mole we've ever gotten. When the yards around you aren't kept up, new ones keep wandering in, so staying on it is the right call. Thanks for trusting us with yours.

author: Alice Collins
reply: Thank you, Alice. We appreciate you taking the time to leave five stars. Call us anytime if new mounds show up.

author: Joseph Irwin
reply: Joseph, thank you. Store-bought traps and repellents rarely get the job done, so we hear "tried everything" a lot. Making sure the yard is fully clear before pulling traps is exactly how Luke works. Glad the grass is coming back, and I'll make sure he sees this.

author: Joanie Miller
reply: Thank you, Joanie. We appreciate the five stars, and we're here if the moles ever try to come back.

author: Moolee H.
reply: Thank you, Moolee. Keeping you in the loop from first call to the last visit matters to us, so we're glad that came through. We appreciate the recommendation.

author: Stacey Boydell
reply: Stacey, thank you. Once you understand how moles move through a yard, the process makes a lot more sense, so we always take the time to explain it. Glad it was a good experience.

author: Adam Rodgers
reply: Adam, thank you. One mole really can wreck a backyard in a couple of months, and three weeks of waiting only gives it more time to dig. Moles are all we do, so we're glad we could get yours fast. Call us if anything new shows up.
